lines.text: Both cards swipe the exact same way at registers, but using a debit card carries vastly higher financial danger.
When you swipe a debit card, money is pulled instantly straight out of your personal checking account.
If a gas pump skimmer steals your debit card info, a hacker drains your actual rent money before dinner.
Federal regulations give you only limited liability protection if you don't report debit fraud immediately.
With a credit card, you are spending the bank's money, not your own.
If fraudulent charges occur, federal law caps your liability at zero dollars, and the bank fights to recover its funds.
Use credit cards for safety and rewards, but always pay off the balance in full every single month.
